claims.text: Understanding VWC
claims.note: Tile title.

claims.text: Measured, modelled and target volumetric water content.
claims.note: Tile summary. Measured is today's scan mean, modelled is the Option 2 estimate for a station not scanned today, and target is the editable Target VWC.

claims.text: Three different numbers wear the label VWC.
claims.note: Avg. VWC carries either the measured or the modelled value (sa-dash-table.component.ts:365-383), and Target VWC is the third.

claims.text: Knowing which one you are reading explains most surprises.
claims.note: Editorial. The visual cue that separates the two Avg. VWC readings is covered under understanding-vwc/2/3.

claims.text: Table, Avg. VWC and Target VWC
claims.note: SPATIAL_ADJUST.AVG_VWC "Avg. VWC" and SPATIAL_ADJUST.TARGET_VWC "Target VWC" are table column headers; at area and hole level the second reads SPATIAL_ADJUST.AVG_TARGET_VWC "Avg. Target VWC".

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, with a hole’s stations in the table.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understanding-vwc/where/1; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: No dialog open.
claims.note: The push, settings and announcement dialogs open over the dashboard from the toolbar (:94-112); the guide starts with none open.

claims.text: A Spatial Adjust account on a site with TurfRad scan data, on a desktop or tablet.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims dashboard-overview/before/1, dashboard-overview/before/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: VWC is volumetric water content, expressed as a percentage of soil volume.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 (introduction) expands VWC as "volumetric water content", and the table shows it with a % sign (sa-table-card.component.html:30), but neither the guide nor the source says what the percentage is of. The value is TurfRad's moisture_mean, passed through unchanged (SpatialAdjustService.cs:3004-3012).
claims.question: Is TurfRad's moisture_mean volumetric water content as a percentage of soil volume (water volume ÷ soil volume × 100)?

claims.text: Measured: the scan mean
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: In the [[Avg. VWC]] column, find a station scanned today.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understanding-vwc/1/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Its value is in plain black text: the mean VWC that TurfRad measured across the station.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understanding-vwc/1/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: It is a measurement, and it is the number the calculation prefers.

claims.text: If every value is grey and italic, nothing was scanned today.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims understanding-vwc/1/2, understanding-vwc/1/5; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: See Get fresh scan data.
claims.note: Cross-reference to the guide that explains the scan request. The toolbar button with tooltip SPATIAL_ADJUST.REQUEST_SCAN_DATA is the control that guide covers (:49-59); scans are requested from TurfRad for the last seven days (SpatialAdjustService.cs:2510).

claims.text: The calculation uses a measured value whenever there is one.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understanding-vwc/1/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: A current scan: black text, today’s date.
claims.note: Figure caption. A current value has no sa-vwc-estimated class, so it keeps the default text colour; the scan date beside the name is always grey (sa-table-card.component.html:24).

claims.text: Modelled: the fallback
claims.note: Step title. Option 2 only; see understanding-vwc/2/2.

claims.text: Find a station whose [[Avg. VWC]] is grey and italic, with a calculator icon.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims understanding-vwc/2/2, understanding-vwc/2/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: That value is modelled: carried forward from the last scan and the weather since.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understanding-vwc/2/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: If no value is grey, every station was scanned today, or [[Option 1]] is set in Settings, which models nothing.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims understanding-vwc/2/2, dashboard-overview/1/5; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Station 7AP1 has no current scan; the value shown is modelled.
claims.note: Figure caption. The station name is the figure's sample data.

claims.text: Target: your input
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: Find the [[Target VWC]] box on the same row.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understanding-vwc/3/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Target VWC is a whole number from 0 to 50 that you set per station.

claims.text: It holds a whole number from 0 to 50 that you set, the only VWC on the row you can type into.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims understanding-vwc/3/2, understanding-vwc/3/4, understanding-vwc/3/5; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: If the row shows [[Avg. Target VWC]], it is a hole or area row.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understanding-vwc/5/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Select a hole row to see its stations.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim dashboard-overview/4/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Higher targets ask for more water.
claims.note: A higher target raises the delta, the amount and so the suggestion under Option 2 (SpatialAdjustService.cs:3033-3043), until the Daily Max Amount caps it; under Option 1 the suggestion scales with target ÷ measured (sa-algorithm.service.ts:58-60).

claims.text: Target VWC accepts 0 to 50, integers only.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: The delta is what drives the suggestion
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: Compare a station’s [[Target VWC]] with its [[Avg. VWC]].
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understanding-vwc/4/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Compare a station’s [[Target VWC]] with its [[Avg.

claims.text: The bigger the delta, the higher the [[Suggested]] percent, up to the daily maximum.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understanding-vwc/4/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: If [[Suggested]] sits at the same top value on many rows, the daily maximum is capping it.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim editing-station-targets/3/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: See Calculation settings.
claims.note: Cross-reference to the Calculation tab of the Settings dialog, first in the rail (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:52-57; html:33).

claims.text: Today’s ET is added to the delta, so a hot, dry day raises the suggestions.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understanding-vwc/4/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Target minus measured, per station, is the whole idea.
claims.note: Under Option 2 the difference is taken per station name, and a multi-sprinkler station shares one adjustment (SpatialAdjustService.cs:3024-3028). Option 1 uses the ratio instead (sa-algorithm.service.ts:58-60).

claims.text: Aggregate rows average their children
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: Find a hole row, with [[Avg. Target VWC]] and [[Last Scan]] columns.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims understanding-vwc/5/2, understanding-vwc/5/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Each value averages the stations under the row, and [[Last Scan]] is the newest scan beneath it.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understanding-vwc/5/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: If you see [[Target VWC]] boxes, you are at station level.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims understanding-vwc/3/4, understanding-vwc/3/5; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Select the area’s name at the top left to go up.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim dashboard-overview/4/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: A grey calculator icon means at least one station beneath the row is modelled.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understanding-vwc/5/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Hole rows: average measured, average target, latest scan.
claims.note: Figure caption. "Average measured" includes modelled values for stations not scanned today under Option 2 (spatial-adjust-course.model.ts:73-85).

claims.text: You can tell a measured value from a modelled one without checking the date.
claims.note: Station rows: grey italic with a calculator icon when modelled. Sprinkler rows: an orange calculator icon. See understanding-vwc/2/3.

claims.text: You know Target VWC is capped at 50.
claims.note: Retyped from label to behaviour. The input max is 50 and bulk changes clamp to 50 (SpatialAdjustLogic.cs:93-105).
